- Model consistently underestimates prices, especially in the early part of the forecast horizon; adjust upward by 2–5% for the first 5–10 days.
- After sharp price spikes (e.g., >95), model overreacts and overshoots for 3–5 days; cap forecast at +3% above peak or use moving average to smooth.
- Mean reversion is strong in the last 5–7 days of the forecast; reduce forecast slope by 10–20% after day 25.
- Forecast drifts downward after day 15–20; apply upward bias correction if historical mean of last 7 days is > forecast.
- Avoid linear extrapolation; use exponential decay or weighted moving average for recent data (last 5–7 days) to capture momentum.
